Crash Causes Blackout In Paintsville - LEX18.com | Continuous News and StormTracker Weather Member Center: Crash Causes Blackout In Paintsville Posted: Updated: EKB 
JOHNSON COUNTY, Ky. (EKB).– A single vehicle accident near Mountain Manor Nursing Home caused nearly half the residents in Paintsville to lose power for a short time Thursay evening. 
According to police, a vehicle traveling on Route 40/Euclid Avenue, left the roadway, ran onto the sidewalk, traveled over an embankment, into a resident’s back yard and struck an power pole head-on. The driver of the vehicle was transported to Paul B. Hall Medical Center to be treated for her injuries. 
American Electric Power officials say customers were without power for several hours.
